title: Oldest Known Roman Library in Spain Identified at Ancient Villa
description: Archaeologists have identified the oldest known library on the Iberian Peninsula inside a Roman villa in southern Spain, overturning decades of belief that the room was a sanctuary dedicated to the Roman god Mithras.The discovery was made at the Roman villa of Fuente Álamo in Puente Genil, in Spain's Córdoba province. title: Oldest Reptile Gut on Record: Austronaga Fossil Reveals Archosaur Stomachs Started Simple
description: Austronaga minuta fossil, a 245-million-year-old Triassic marine reptile from southern China, preserves the oldest known largely complete reptile digestive system ever recorded, revealing that early archosaurs had a single-chambered stomach — contradicting long-held assumptions about archosaur stomach evolution and providing insight into Triassic soft-tissue preservation.

title: Archaeologists find hundreds of ancient glyphs in the Amazon
description: The vast earthen designs contradict previous theories and depictions of the region as largely untouched prior to the arrival of European colonists.
